meta.extractiveQuote: Find the perimeter of an isosceles right triangle, the length of whose hypotenuse is 10 cm. (2 marks)

text: Let each equal leg have length a. By Pythagoras, 2a²=10², so a=5√2 cm. The perimeter is 10+5√2+5√2=10(√2+1) cm.

text: 25. Why does a magnetic compass needle pointing North and South in the absence of a nearby magnet get deflected when a bar magnet or a current carrying loop is brought near it. Describe some salient features of magnetic lines of field concept.

meta.subject: science
meta.heading: Magnetic Effects of Electric Current · NCERT Exemplar Question 25
meta.sourceVisualMatch: Question Q25 was visually checked against the rendered original Magnetic Effects Exemplar PDF page 5; its official answer was visually checked on ANSWERS_2026.pdf page 52. Text is complete and does not depend on an omitted figure.

text: 25. Current carrying loops behave like bar magnets and both have their associated lines of field. This modifies the already existing earth’s magnetic field and a deflection results. Magnetic field has both direction and magnitude. Magnetic field lines emerge from N-pole and enter S-pole. The magnetic field strength is represented diagrammatically by the degree of closeness of the field lines. Field lines cannot cross each other as two values of net field at a single point cannot exist. Only one value, a unique net value, can exist. If in a given region, lines of field are shown to be parallel and equi-spaced, the field is understood to be uniform.
